lines.text: In 1925, a soldier chasing his dog accidentally started a war.

parts.tts: In nineteen twenty-five, a soldier chasing his dog accidentally started a war.
parts.heard: In 1925, a soldier chasing his dog accidentally started a war.

lines.text: At least, that's the classic account.

parts.tts: At least, that's the classic account.
parts.heard: At least, that's the classic account.

lines.text: A Greek soldier's dog ran across the Bulgarian border, and he chased after it.

parts.tts: A Greek soldier's dog ran across the Bulgarian border, and he chased after it.
parts.heard: A Greek soldier's dog ran across the Bulgarian border, and he chased after it.

lines.text: A Bulgarian sentry saw him... and shot him.
The Greek version is different: Bulgarian troops crossed over and attacked a Greek outpost.

parts.tts: The Greek version is different: Bulgarian troops crossed over and attacked a Greek outpost.
parts.heard: The Greek version is different. Bulgarian troops crossed over and attacked a Greek outpost.

lines.text: But here's where it gets wild. Greece gave Bulgaria 48 hours: apologize, punish those responsible, and pay 2 million francs.

parts.tts: But here's where it gets wild. Greece gave Bulgaria forty-eight hours: apologize, punish those responsible, and pay two million francs.
parts.heard: But here's where it gets wild. Greece gave Bulgaria 48 hours, apologize, punish those responsible, and pay two million francs.

lines.text: Then Greek troops marched into Bulgaria, toward the town of Petrich.

parts.tts: Then Greek troops marched into Bulgaria, toward the town of Petrich.
parts.heard: Then, Greek troops marched into Bulgaria toward the town of Petrich.

lines.text: Bulgaria appealed to the League of Nations... which ordered a ceasefire hours before the attack.

parts.tts: Bulgaria appealed to the League of Nations...
parts.heard: Bulgaria appealed to the League of Nations.

parts.tts: which ordered a ceasefire hours before the attack.
parts.heard: which ordered a ceasefire hours before the attack.

lines.text: Greece had to pull out and pay Bulgaria 45,000 pounds.

parts.tts: Greece had to pull out and pay Bulgaria forty-five thousand pounds.
parts.heard: Greece had to pull out and pay Bulgaria 45,000 pounds.

lines.text: Ten days. Dozens of lives lost... and history calls it the War of the Stray Dog.

and history calls it the War of the Stray Dog.
